native_ui_checks: Connected-provider filters; bounded pinch/pan, optional smoothing and shared rate chart
Notification controls and per-provider overrides persist across relaunch
Fresh low-allowance and caught-up approaching-reset alerts; scheduled reset delivered while app backgrounded
Exact shared circular, rectangular and inline accessory content at accessory dimensions
History selection bounds, event popups and calendar heatmaps
Six-account Home Screen widget persistence after app termination and account row deep link

test_runs.failure: Accessory text query expected an exact static label; SwiftUI exposes the combined account/metric accessibility label. Screenshot showed correct ring rendering. Query corrected and test rerun.

tests.last_change_after_simulator_checks: Added known reset dates to accessory timelines so relative text switches to Reset due at the deadline. Release compilation verifies extension packaging.

lock_screen.layout_check: Extension uses the exact shared content rendered by a DEBUG-only app harness at accessory sizes. Harness is compiled out of Release.

design_review.final_verdict: No material shipping defects in the four screenshots or three source files reviewed.
findings_resolved: Tooltip matching before limiting comparison series
Warning re-arm for no-reset quotas and reset-time key jitter
Distinct same-provider swatches, wrapping interactive legend and lime Smooth state
Accessory entries at known reset deadlines
physical_device_follow_ups: System Lock Screen masking, vibrancy and inline truncation beside date
Longer-term delivery with Focus and notification grouping

limits: Background refresh timing remains controlled by iOS. Low-allowance and observed-event detection require successful provider refreshes.
Rate averaging describes consumption between recorded samples, not instantaneous token throughput. Intervals longer than six hours remain unknown.
No provider login or usage protocol changed; opt-in live networking tests were not rerun.
The iOS 18 simulator omits Wallpaper settings. Actual Lock Screen gallery configuration was not tested; shared content, intent selection logic and release compilation were checked.
